topic: The Original iPhone Had No Copy-Paste for Two Full Years
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

The original iPhone, a device that changed the world, launched without one of the most basic features we use every day: Copy and Paste!

Here's why this mind-blowing fact is true:
🔹 Launched in 2007, the iPhone prioritized innovative multi-touch gestures.
🔹 Apple wanted to ensure a 'perfect' copy-paste experience with gestures, taking time.
🔹 The feature finally arrived two years later in 2009 with iPhone OS 3.0!
